detail.longDescription:
A longstanding unsolved problem in mathematics since the early 20th century solved by OpenAI in 88 hours with a swarm of around 10,000 AI agents running an internal frontier model.

The swarm produced:

~4.9 million messages
~300 billion output tokens

and

~2.7 million messages
~130 billion output tokens

on Navier–Stokes specifically.

The claimed solution was reached on 5 September after 88 hours of work.
